scope: Failure handling and resource cleanup — cases a and b, the profile post and media half
result_scope: V-10-a and V-10-b. V-10-c (concurrent room saves) is WP-07, V-10-d/e (room scene disposal) is WP-07.

cases.claim: Photo upload cancelled mid-flight → no orphan post, staged media cleaned.
client_evidence: frontend/src/features/profile-media/__tests__/failure.test.tsx::cancelling_before_finalize_never_publishes_and_never_creates_a_post — the byte upload is held open, the composer is cancelled, and the recorded requests are exactly the init and the put: no finalize, no create. Nothing was published.

frontend/src/features/profile-media/__tests__/failure.test.tsx::the_upload_reports_its_phase_as_cancelled_and_never_ready — the upload state is `cancelled`, `media` is null, and the staged media id is reported so the caller can say it will be cleaned.

frontend/src/features/profile-media/__tests__/failure.test.tsx::leaving_the_screen_mid_upload_cancels_cleanly — unmounting the composer aborts the in-flight upload; no finalize and no create is sent afterwards.
server_evidence: backend/services/concert-service/tests/profile_media_upload.rs::a_cancelled_upload_leaves_no_orphan_once_the_window_passes — an init with no bytes is PENDING, unattached and erased by the orphan window.

backend/services/concert-service/tests/profile_media_upload.rs::an_uploaded_but_never_finalized_asset_is_also_cleaned — an upload that reached PUT but never finalized is erased too, and its staged bytes are cleared.
backend/services/concert-service/tests/profile_media_upload.rs::an_abandoned_upload_is_cleaned_after_the_orphan_window — a fresh upload and a READY asset survive the same run.
backend/services/concert-service/tests/profile_media_upload.rs::cleanup_never_erases_media_a_live_post_still_uses — a READY asset is never an orphan.
cases.note: The client cannot delete a PENDING row: the frozen §2.3 contract has no delete-media operation. The guarantee is therefore that a cancelled upload never reaches finalize and never creates a post, so the only row it can leave is a PENDING intent with no bytes, which the server's 24-hour orphan window erases. Both halves are asserted.

cases.claim: Photo upload fails → the composer keeps the draft and offers retry.
evidence: frontend/src/features/profile-media/__tests__/failure.test.tsx::keeps_the_description_the_visibility_and_the_alt_text_after_a_failed_publish — after a failed create the description, visibility and alt text are exactly what the user typed, and the retry sends the same draft.
frontend/src/features/profile-media/__tests__/failure.test.tsx::keeps_the_draft_when_the_upload_itself_fails — a failed init keeps the draft and creates no post.

frontend/src/features/profile-media/__tests__/failure.test.tsx::renders_the_failure_and_the_retry_affordance — the failure line says the draft is kept, the description field still holds the text, and the publish button is enabled again.
frontend/src/features/profile-media/__tests__/failure.test.tsx::the_failure_vocabulary — only transient failures are retryable, and no user-facing line carries a server diagnostic.

commands.command: cd frontend && corepack pnpm@11.7.0 exec vitest run src/features/profile-media
cd backend && cargo +1.88.0 test --locked -p concert-service --test profile_media_upload
